title: Quest codes and bonus rewards
summary:
Quest codes and visible agent tool calls arrived alongside shape-preserving image edits, easier OAuth consent, and a tidier model catalog.

The Quests overview gained a place to redeem campaign codes. Each code can reveal a hidden quest and immediately claim its Pollen reward once per campaign. Bonus rewards without catalog entries now appear with a claim flow.

Agent responses now include tool-call details in streaming and non-streaming output: tool name, arguments, and the resulting text or failure. Managed-agent configuration was narrowed to built-in Pollinations MCP tools, with a simpler dashboard switch and CLI status. An MCP redirect-handling fix also merged, and the agent form lost a few redundant labels.

When an image edit omits `size`, dimensions now follow the first source image’s aspect ratio instead of defaulting to a square. OAuth consent details can scroll within short screens, keeping authorize actions accessible even when permissions expand.

highlights.title: Redeem Quest codes
highlights.text: Enter a campaign code in Quests to uncover a hidden quest and claim its Pollen reward. Bonus rewards also have a place to claim them.

highlights.title: See agent tool calls
highlights.text: Managed-agent responses now show tool names, arguments, and text results or failures in streaming and non-streaming output. Generated media links stay in the response. [Explore the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
